name: @appbana/metadata-registry
description: Append-only, content-addressed store for BIM/AIM/CAM triples. Every artifact is keyed by sha-256 of its canonicalised bytes. `record()` is idempotent (same bytes → same id → dedupe). Reads recompute the content hash and throw ContentHashMismatchError on drift, providing tamper detection. Ships InMemoryMetadataRegistry (tests), JsonlMetadataRegistry (durable, air-gapped), and PostgresMetadataRegistry (production, `pg` optional peer dep). Includes `verifyProvenanceChain(bim, aim, cam)` that ties the WS-1.3 pipeline together.
